document_api_meta.title: Submit Customs Clearance Information
document_api_meta.env_desc: This API is used to submit extra customs clearance information for discrepancies between declared information and physical goods.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_body_param.name: order_list
request_body_param.desc: List of orders for which to submit customs clearance information. Maximum: 100 orders per request.

request_body_param.name: ^item_list
request_body_param.desc: List of customs clearance entries for order lines. Within the same order, explicit order_line_id values must be unique.

request_body_param.name: ^^order_line_id
request_body_param.desc: Sub order ID; order_line_id and sku_id should not be both empty.

request_body_param.name: ^^sku_id
request_body_param.desc: SKU ID; order_line_id and sku_id should not be both empty.

request_body_param.name: ^^item_detail
request_body_param.desc: List of SKU-level customs clearance details for the order line.

request_body_param.name: ^^^sku_id
request_body_param.desc: The SKU ID for this customs clearance detail.

request_body_param.name: ^^^qty
request_body_param.desc: Quantity of this SKU in the customs clearance detail. Must be greater than 0.

request_body_param.name: ^^^price_percent
request_body_param.desc: Percentage assigned to this SKU within the order line. Each value must be non-negative, and the price_percent values in item_detail must total 100. For example, 10 means 10%.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
